findings.detail: The leaf fits and optimizes per-analyte calibration regressions with an internal-standard correction option, but does not explicitly assess the requested lower limit of quantification.
The leaf computes targeted-MS QC RSDs, flags outliers and assesses pooled-QC between-batch correction, but does not describe the requested intra-batch drift assessment.
The leaf converts targeted LC-MS peak areas to calibrated concentrations with optional internal-standard correction, but provides method-comparison statistics rather than per-measurement uncertainty.
The leaf processes multiplexed capillary-electrophoresis MS data using migration-index rules and deposited assay calibrations, rather than applying the supplied targeted LC-MS calibration curves.
The leaf tabulates internal-standard retention-time, intensity and mass-error metrics for an acquisition dashboard, rather than producing a calibrated analyte quantification report.
The leaf derives instrument peak-quality metrics and outlier reports from raw MS files, rather than consolidating analyte concentrations and calibration/QC results.
